sloka: तेषां वरुणपुत्राणां हत्वा योधान्हयाञ्छतान् ।मुमोचाशु महानादं विरथान्प्रेक्ष्य तान्स्थितान् ।। ७.२३.३८ ॥
transliteration: teṣāṁ varuṇaputrāṇāṁ hatvā yodhānhayāñchatān ।mumocāśu mahānādaṁ virathānprekṣya tānsthitān ।। 7.23.38 ॥

translations.english: Having killed hundreds of warriors and horses belonging to the sons of Varuna, Mahodara quickly let out a great roar upon seeing them standing dismounted from their chariots.
